records.prompt:
Create a transparent RGBA sprite sheet with SIX separate full-body cels, exactly 2 rows by 3 columns, reading left-to-right. No text, numbers, effects, ground, scenery, backdrop, other people or motion blur. Entire hammer and both boots fully visible with generous transparent margins/gutters. Truly transparent empty areas, not an opaque brown backdrop.
REFERENCE 1 defines the exact character model, identity, physique, CAMERA and FACING for this sheet. REFERENCE 2 defines the compact stocky body model and SIX-POSE movement sequence already validated. Reproject those six poses into the camera of reference 1.
CAMERA: FRONT view facing DOWN toward the viewer. Chest, face, both shoulders and boots face the bottom of screen. Match reference 1 front camera, do not copy the side profile of reference 2.
The SAME detailed hand-painted chibi wuxia warrior: red-brown ponytail/ribbons, short beard (hidden from rear as appropriate), purple-brown coat with thick gray fur trim, red sash, bronze bracers, large fur boots, large rectangular purple/bronze hammer on a medium-long wooden shaft. Match reference 1 LARGE head, compact SHORT torso and SHORT thick limbs; never become a tall slender human. The chest-to-belt length, thigh/shin lengths, head width, cuff diameter, boot length and rigid hammer dimensions stay CONSTANT in all six cels. Same drawing density and fixed camera, no zoom or rescaling per pose.
Cel 1: EXACT idle ready stance from reference 1 with hammer held across waist. This is the ANATOMY CALIBRATION pose.
Cel 2: low preparation from cel 2 of reference 2: tool head low left near knee, shaft across waist, two hands grip, torso turns, legs stay SHORT and planted.
Cel 3: shoulder load from cel 3 of reference 2: both hands close together beside right temple/shoulder, hammer head high behind crown/opposite upper silhouette, elbows bent, torso coils. Same head and body dimensions as cel 1.
Cel 4: broad cross-body sweep from cel 4 of reference 2: BOTH arms extend together in front as hips turn, tool head out forward at chest/shoulder height. No extra arm length, tall torso or lengthened legs. Retain compact squat chibi anatomy.
Cel 5: low opposite-side follow-through from cel 5 of reference 2: both close hands near right hip, shaft diagonally down-left to tool head beside outside of left knee; head NOT planted on the ground. Coiled torso and bent knees still use identical short anatomy.
Cel 6: EXACT SAME calibration idle pose and scale as cel 1, matching reference 1.
Exactly two connected hands per cel, naturally gripping the same continuous handle, adjacent grip during motion. Real anatomical occlusion in the requested camera. Six independently drawn poses, all the same person at one physical pixel density. Preserve reference 1 physique and view over any incompatible silhouette from reference 2.
